note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the communication and the sections of the termination clause are generic placeholders, never real contract text or notices. "Provided for" and "not described" are supplied cases of equal weight (● and ◆ of the same area, colour and stroke); the thread only shows the link that is supplied. No termination doctrine is stated: no ground or right to terminate, no notice period or time limit, no effect, no validity or sufficiency judgement, and no jurisdiction; the case "not described" is neutral (no thread, no conclusion). Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): schedules, definitions and priorities; clauses = the sections of the termination clause.
